- **Cash:** 713,481, down 215,543 from May and down 1,871,836 from six months earlier (2,585,317).

- **Expense movers:** Bad Debts went from 12,935 to (1,806), which pulled Finance & Admin negative. Events & Conferences rose 17,971 to 29,295.
- **Zero expense lines:** four lines are zero, kept as "zero in June" vs "zero since an earlier month" as flagged.
- **December 2025 spikes:** stock-based compensation (334,661) and bonus (80,343) look like single-month items, worded for the reviewer to confirm.
